content: Harborlight Support Portal is a fictional customer-support workspace being prepared for a small enterprise pilot.
The team scheduled the customer pilot for September 30, 2026 after an internal alpha review.
The enterprise pilot may not begin until single sign-on and audit logging have both passed the readiness checklist.
Operations owns the onboarding checklist and coordinates pilot-readiness updates with Support and Engineering.
Project status updates should be concise and organized into decisions, risks, and next actions.
The team decided to hold pilot-readiness reviews every Wednesday afternoon until launch.
A rollback checklist was requested for the pilot launch so the team can restore the prior workflow if deployment validation fails.
The public demo uses synthetic project information only and should not store passwords, access tokens, private keys, financial account data, medical records, or confidential client information.
